title: .NET Developer
description: A comprehensive roadmap for mastering modern .NET development, encompassing C# language proficiency, robust ASP.NET Core API design, secure data management with Entity Framework, advanced testing strategies, architectural patterns, and scalable cloud deployment with DevOps practices.

tree.name: C# and .NET Foundations
tree.description: Master the C# language, understand the .NET runtime (CLR, BCL), object-oriented programming, fundamental data structures, error handling, and essential development tooling for building robust applications.

children.name: C# Language Fundamentals
children.description: Learn basic syntax, primitive data types, control flow statements (if/else, loops, switch), methods, classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and abstraction. Understand value and reference types.

children.name: Advanced C# Features
children.description: Dive into generics for reusable code, Language Integrated Query (LINQ) for data manipulation, asynchronous programming (async/await) for responsive applications, delegates and events for flexible design, pattern matching for conditional logic, records for immutable data, and nullable reference types for preventing null-related errors.

resources.title: Asynchronous programming with async and await (Microsoft Docs)

children.name: Data Structures & Algorithms in C#
children.description: Understand and implement common data structures like arrays, lists, dictionaries, stacks, queues, hash sets, and basic algorithms for searching and sorting using C# collections and generic types. Analyze time and space complexity.

children.name: .NET CLI and Development Tooling
children.description: Learn to use the .NET Command-Line Interface (CLI) for project creation and management, understand the structure of solutions and projects (.csproj), master NuGet package management for dependencies, and utilize debugging and profiling techniques effectively in Visual Studio/VS Code.

children.name: File I/O and Basic Networking
children.description: Understand how to interact with file systems (reading/writing files), utilize streams for efficient data handling, perform basic network operations using HttpClient for web requests, and implement data serialization/deserialization (JSON, XML).

tree.name: ASP.NET Core Web API Development
tree.description: Learn to build robust, scalable, and secure RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core, covering core concepts like HTTP, routing, middleware, dependency injection, and data transfer objects (DTOs).

children.name: HTTP & RESTful API Fundamentals
children.description: Understand the core principles of HTTP (methods, status codes, headers), RESTful architectural style, resource identification, statelessness, and effective design of API endpoints for client-server communication.

children.name: ASP.NET Core Fundamentals
children.description: Set up ASP.NET Core projects, understand the application's startup process (Program.cs), configure the request processing pipeline using middleware, and master Dependency Injection (DI) for loose coupling and testability.

children.name: Controllers & Minimal APIs
children.description: Implement API endpoints efficiently using both MVC controllers with attributes and the modern minimal API approach. Cover routing, model binding, action results, input/output formatters, and integrate OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.

resources.title: Create web APIs with ASP.NET Core

children.name: API Validation & Error Handling
children.description: Implement robust data validation using built-in data annotations or external libraries like FluentValidation. Design comprehensive error handling strategies for API responses, including custom exception filters, global error handling middleware, and standardized problem details (RFC 7807).

resources.title: Model validation in ASP.NET Core MVC and Razor Pages
Handle errors in ASP.NET Core Web APIs

children.name: Authentication & Authorization
children.description: Secure your APIs using ASP.NET Core Identity for user management, implement JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for stateless authentication, enforce fine-grained authorization policies based on roles, claims, and custom policies, and understand security best practices (e.g., CORS, CSRF, XSS).

resources.title: Authentication and authorization in ASP.NET Core
Bearer token authentication with ASP.NET Core Identity

tree.name: Data Access and Persistence
tree.description: Implement efficient data access layers using Entity Framework Core, including database migrations, powerful querying with LINQ, advanced database interactions, and strategies for performance optimization.

children.name: Relational Database Basics
children.description: Learn fundamental SQL concepts (DDL, DML, DCL), relational database design principles, data normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF), primary/foreign keys, indexing, and basic to intermediate querying techniques (JOINs, aggregations).

children.name: EF Core Fundamentals
children.description: Work with DbContext for database interactions, define entity models, perform Create, Read, Update, Delete (CRUD) operations, manage database schema changes using migrations, and understand change tracking.

children.name: Advanced EF Core Topics
children.description: Explore complex relationships (many-to-many, one-to-one), various data loading strategies (eager, lazy, explicit), advanced LINQ to Entities querying (projections, groupings), database transactions, executing raw SQL, and implementing performance optimization techniques like compiled queries and connection pooling.

children.name: Alternative Data Stores & Caching
children.description: Gain an introduction to NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB, DynamoDB) and their use cases. Understand in-memory (e.g., IMemoryCache) and distributed caching strategies using technologies like Redis to significantly improve application performance and reduce database load.

tree.name: Quality, Architecture & Advanced Practices
tree.description: Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable .NET applications through comprehensive testing strategies, modern architectural patterns, advanced observability, and robust security practices.

children.name: Unit & Integration Testing
children.description: Write effective unit tests with popular frameworks (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest), use mocking frameworks (Moq, NSubstitute) for isolating dependencies, and perform integration tests for ASP.NET Core APIs using WebApplicationFactory and external dependencies via Testcontainers.

children.name: Architectural Patterns & Design Principles
children.description: Apply SOLID principles for maintainable code, understand common architectural patterns like Layered Architecture, Clean Architecture, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), and gain an introduction to Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.

resources.title: Architecting Cloud Native .NET Applications for Azure

children.name: Background Processing & Messaging
children.description: Implement background services and long-running tasks using IHostedService, manage asynchronous operations with queues (e.g., Azure Queue Storage, Hangfire), schedule tasks, and integrate message brokers like RabbitMQ or Kafka for reliable asynchronous communication in distributed systems.

resources.title: Implement background tasks with hosted services in ASP.NET Core

children.name: Observability (Logging, Metrics, Tracing)
children.description: Master structured logging (Serilog, NLog), collect and analyze application metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) to track requests across services, and understand health checks for monitoring service availability.

children.name: Resilience & Performance
children.description: Build resilient applications using patterns like retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts (e.g., with Polly). Learn advanced caching strategies (e.g., response caching, output caching), implement performance profiling, and optimize database interactions and API endpoints for optimal speed and resource utilization.

resources.title: Performance best practices in ASP.NET Core

tree.name: Deployment, DevOps & Project Showcase
tree.description: Deploy .NET applications to cloud environments, implement robust CI/CD pipelines, monitor production systems, and build a comprehensive portfolio project demonstrating full-stack capabilities and modern DevOps practices.

children.name: Containerization with Docker
children.description: Learn to containerize .NET applications using Docker, write efficient Dockerfiles, manage Docker images and registries, and use Docker Compose for orchestrating multi-container development and local testing environments.

children.name: Cloud Deployment on Azure
children.description: Deploy .NET applications to various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Understand environment configuration, secrets management (Azure Key Vault), scaling strategies, and cost optimization.

resources.title: Deploy ASP.NET Core to Azure App Service

children.name: CI/CD Pipelines
children.description: Implement Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CD) pipelines using industry-standard tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, or GitLab CI. Automate build, test, static analysis, security scanning, and deployment processes.

resources.title: Build and deploy .NET Core app to Azure with Azure DevOps

children.name: Production Monitoring & Alerting
children.description: Set up and configure comprehensive monitoring solutions like Azure Monitor and Application Insights to track application health, performance metrics, user behavior, and logs in production. Configure actionable alerts for critical issues and integrate with incident management systems.

children.name: Portfolio Project: Comprehensive API
children.description: Develop a real-world, end-to-end ASP.NET Core API project (e.g., an e-commerce backend, a task management system, or a social media API). Incorporate all learned skills: robust EF Core data access, secure authentication and authorization, comprehensive testing, Dockerization, CI/CD pipeline integration, and deployment to a cloud environment.
